thesis: Zeroing under 0.05% of weights retains prior-task accuracy under RL, while full fine-tuning, LoRA and random sparse fine-tuning lose up to 5.4 points.
rationale: The image shows four post-training methods side by side with two stat cards: Deletion Tuning stays near base accuracy, while FFT, LoRA and random sparse fine-tuning lose up to 5.4 points — carrying the caption's argument that what training selects to remove matters more than how much it moves.
title: Deletion *Tuning* Forgets Far Less
subhead: FFT, LoRA and random sparse fine-tuning lose up to 5.4 points

insight_cards.caption: Deletion Tuning stays near base accuracy
Others lose up to 5.4 points under RL
